title: Stegra's Boden green steel project under construction in Sweden; all 37 electrolyser modules installed
dek: All 37 electrolyser modules have been installed at Stegra's Boden green steel project in Sweden, which remains under construction, according to Shanghai Metals Market.
summary: Stegra's green steel project at Boden in Sweden is under construction, and all 37 electrolyser modules have been installed, according to a Shanghai Metals Market headline. The publisher's excerpt gives no detail on capacity, commissioning dates or costs.
whyItMatters: Boden is among the most closely watched hydrogen-based steelmaking projects, and completion of electrolyser installation is a tangible construction milestone.
implications: Buyers seeking low-emission steel and rival producers planning hydrogen routes may treat progress at Boden as a signal of the pathway's practical feasibility; the timing of first production remains the key point to watch.
